subtopics: programmed I/O: the CPU busy in a status loop for the whole transfer
interrupt-driven I/O: the wait removed, the per-byte service routine kept
DMA: the CPU out of the data path, with cycle stealing and burst as the two ways to share the bus
the arithmetic that compares the three schemes on one 500-byte block

example.note: The device time of 200 cycles per byte is this lesson's stated assumption; the 7 and 2 cycle figures are the loop of GATE CSE 2011 Q.28, and the 20 and 2 are that question's DMA figures. Every number here is recomputed in scripts/validate.py.
